summary: Completed end-to-end testing of Client Proposals feature. All 30 tests passed (9 backend API tests, 16 frontend UI tests, 5 regression tests). Feature is fully functional with correct pricing calculations, PDF generation, WhatsApp integration, and proper sidebar navigation.

Backend: GET /api/proposals returns empty list initially
Backend: POST /api/proposals creates proposal with ref_number CON-2026-0001
Backend: POST /api/proposals returns 422 for missing client_name (validation works)
Backend: GET /api/proposals/{id} returns proposal details
Backend: PUT /api/proposals/{id} updates proposal (status, area, discount)
Backend: GET /api/proposals/{id}/pdf downloads 17.9KB PDF
Backend: DELETE /api/proposals/{id} removes proposal
Backend: GET /api/proposals/{id} returns 404 after delete
Frontend: Admin login with dkmanjeshbelli@gmail.com works
Frontend: Client Proposals link visible in sidebar between Quiz Submissions and Homes
Frontend: Navigate to /admin/proposals shows empty state
Frontend: New Proposal button opens right-side drawer
Frontend: Client details form (name, phone) accepts input
Frontend: Site details form (area: 1500 sq.ft) accepts input
Frontend: Essential package selection works (4 tier cards displayed)
Frontend: Pricing calculation correct (1500 × 1799 = ₹26,98,500 base)
Frontend: GST @ 18% calculation displayed in pricing summary
Frontend: Add-ons section shows 6 add-ons, toggle works
Frontend: Save proposal generates ref_number CON-2026-0001
Frontend: Download PDF button enabled after save
Frontend: Send via WhatsApp button enabled after save
Frontend: Drawer closes on Cancel
Frontend: Saved proposal appears in list with client name, package, area, phone
